calculation_source:
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

source = Path('runs/kaggle_final_staged_output')
out = Path('results/kaggle/staged-final-v1')
shutil.copytree(source, out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
files = {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in sorted(out.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
cohorts = {}
for path in out.rglob('*.jsonl'):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert sorted(r['seed'] for r in rows) == list(range(200, 400))
    assert all(len(r['rounds']) == 6 for r in rows)
    cohorts[str(path)] = {'episodes': len(rows), 'sha256': files[str(path)]}
pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
assert pair['exit_codes'] == [1, 0]
parity = {name: json.loads((out / ('qwen3.5-4b-staged-' + name) / 'batch_parity.json').read_text())['quotes_equal'] for name in ('sft', 'grpo')}
assert parity == {'sft': False, 'grpo': True}
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain staged final evaluation, including failed SFT train-state parity'}, pair['model_revision']),
     'kernel': 'nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-grpo-qwen3-final-staged', 'version': 1,
     'download_receipt': 'results/training/kaggle_staged_final.json',
     'runtime_file': str(out / 'pair_runtime.json'), 'cohorts': cohorts, 'files_sha256': files,
     'batch_parity': parity,
     'interpretation': 'GRPO completes both 200-episode test cohorts. SFT stops before test on train-state quote mismatch. No aggregate scores inspected for tuning.',
     'calculation_source': Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('results/training/kaggle_staged_final_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json'); b = json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in b['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'] == r['kernel']:
        session.update(status='partial_success_outputs_retrieved', script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'],
                       hours=pair['wall_seconds'] / 3600,
                       hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime only; allocation billing and exact release time unavailable.',
                       observed_complete_at=json.loads(Path(r['download_receipt']).read_text())['polls'][-1]['at'],
                       result_file=r['runtime_file'])
    if session['kernel'].endswith('frozen-grpo-final-resume') and session['version'] == 1:
        session['receipt'] = 'results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume_attempt1.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(b, indent=2) + '\n')
p = Path('README.md'); s = p.read_text().replace('| [Kaggle retry](results/training/kaggle_retry.json) | OAuth recovery, private remote metadata, pinned model and submitted script hash | Accepted submission; execution measurements pending |', '| [Completed CUDA training](results/training/kaggle_staged_completion.json) | Pinned model, trainer configs, adapter hashes and downloaded runtime | SFT and GRPO complete; [test evaluation](results/training/kaggle_staged_final_completion.json) retains GRPO cohorts and failed SFT batching check |')
p.write_text(s)
